hypothesis.statement: Upstream's proof of the scalar sharp Lieb-Thirring theorem (import closure of OAI.Analysis.LiebThirring.Main, 38 local files, 13717 lines, Mathlib only) compiles under LeanMaster's Lean v4.34.0-rc2 + its Mathlib build, and `#print axioms OAI.SharpLiebThirring.sharp_lieb_thirring` lists only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Producer (upstream/OpenAI) != verifier (this machine). This lane does not show the statement equals the intended physics statement; it is a kernel check of the proof term only.
hypothesis.kind: pilot kernel check; version drift (upstream v4.34.1 + its pinned Mathlib vs local v4.34.0-rc2) is a possible outcome and a finding

part1: PILOT_PASS (all 38 compiled AND axiom verdict OK)
PARTIAL (k of 38 compiled, first blocking error recorded)
BLOCKED (infrastructure, e.g. lake env failure or timeouts)
AXIOM_FINDING (compiled but sorryAx or non-whitelisted axiom)
part2: per file: exit code and findings exactly as printed by elenchus_check.py (VACUITY/SMUGGLING/NO_FOOTPRINT/INHERITED_SORRY/BAD_AXIOM/COMPILE_ERROR) or SKIPPED
verdict_categories.statement_lock: 16-hex sha256 prefix per declaration from statement_lock.py --update, plus full sha256 of each of the 4 challenge files

decision_rule.per_file_compiled: lean exit code 0, no output line containing 'error', and the .olean was written; timeout (3000 s per file) = failed
decision_rule.closure_status: dependents of a failed file are 'blocked', never counted compiled; no upstream file is patched; independent files continue
decision_rule.axiom_rule: parse `#print axioms` output; OK iff the theorem's list is a subset of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; sorryAx -> SORRY; others -> BAD_AXIOM; no line for the theorem -> NO_FOOTPRINT (not a pass)
decision_rule.tiering: No claim is Tier A. Even PILOT_PASS only shows the kernel accepted the closure under the local toolchain; the exact challenge statement is Comparator-checked only after the user approves the D2 request (docs/OPENAI_MATH_D2_REQUEST.md). Challenge elaboration (1a) is a statement-parses check, not a proof check.
decision_rule.elenchus: reported verbatim; a challenge file containing `sorry` is expected to produce findings and that is not a defect of the upstream solution

positive: pos_clean.lean: `1+1=2 := rfl` compiles, axiom list empty -> OK
pos_classical.lean: Classical.em -> axioms within whitelist -> OK
controls.rule: controls.json must have _all_pass true (run in the lane before and after the closure) or every Part 1 number is reported as crash; the toposort assertion (every dependency before its dependent) must hold; Elenchus is run on a control pair only if time permits, else this is disclosed
controls.elenchus_note: Elenchus is run unmodified, in-process, with REPO_ROOT monkeypatched to the LeanMaster dir (its default REPO_ROOT is the Elenchus repo, whose toolchain/Mathlib differ) and LEAN_PATH from `lake env`; a deviation from its documented invocation, disclosed.

budget.cpu: 1 core, one Lean process at a time, no GPU
budget.per_bash_call_s: <=540 via --max-seconds 420 resumable slices; long jobs as background process with polling

writes: only the lane dir, docs/OPENAI_MATH_D2_REQUEST.md and scripts/openai_math/lt_d_lean.py; never LeanMaster/.lake or upstream/.lake; never `lake build`; statement_lock run with LEAN_PROJECT_ROOT = lane/lock_root on byte-identical copies
smoke_disclosure: Smoke test in /tmp/ltd_smoke before this file: toposort of the Main closure gave 38 files with all dependencies ordered before dependents; classifier asserts passed; the 5 control files gave the expected verdicts (these ARE control results, to be re-run in the lane); statement_lock --update on copies of the 4 challenge files printed 'locked 101 declarations in 4 files' and --check printed OK. No closure compile, no challenge elaboration, no Elenchus run on the challenges and no axiom result for the theorem has been seen.
open_design_questions: Elenchus on challenge files will probably report NO_FOOTPRINT or sorry-related findings because challenges end in `sorry` by design; no control separates 'challenge-by-design' from a defect
The axiom check uses an importer scratch file rather than a scratch copy of Main.lean (equivalent for the kernel, disclosed)
